deposits.מספר הפקדה: kpi:deposits, insight:concentration — de-duplication key: 3,725 deposits are repeated once per payment method in the export
deposits.מטבע מקור של ההפקדה: skip: amount in the original currency — mixed currencies, not summable; the ILS-converted amount is used instead
deposits.סכום לאחר המרה לשקלים: chart-dep-year, chart-countries, chart-currencies, chart-sizes, kpi:deposits_ils, kpi:ytd, insight:country, insight:concentration, insight:peak
deposits.תאריך הפקדה: skip: 85% empty and contains impossible years (1920s, 2201); receipt date is used instead
deposits.ארץ: skip: export artefact — holds a payment method (check / bank transfer / account transfer) and every deposit that has one is listed with all three, a cross-join with a lookup; carries no per-deposit information
allocations.מספר פנימי של הפרוטוקול: skip: internal protocol identifier; the allocations file has no dates, and dated decisions come from the decisions file
allocations.מספר תיק: chart-sources, insight:sources — estate files ranked by allocated amount; file numbers are never shown
allocations.מספר חשבון פנימי: skip: internal bank-account identifier of an estate file; aggregated at file level instead
cases.מספר תיק: chart-mix — join key between cases and purposes; never shown
cases.ארץ התיק: skip: 91% empty; the filled values look like defaults (two countries with exactly 211 files each)
cases.תאריך סגירה של התיק: skip: dominated by bulk administrative closure dates (1,642 files closed in 1989, 123 dated 1911) and some precede the opening date — closure timing is not reliable
cases.סיבת סגירה של התיק: table:reasons, chart-status — reason recorded for ~29% of closed files (share shown on the page)
cases.האם קיים הקדש: chart-status — endowment share in the status note
purposes.מספר תיק: chart-topics, chart-mix — distinct files per topic; never shown
decisions.מספר פרוטוקול פנימי: skip: internal protocol identifier (identical to מספר פרוטוקול)
decisions.מספר תיק: skip: source estate file of each allocation — file-level detail; money by source file is shown from the allocations file
decisions.סה~כ סכום עליו החליטה הוועדה: chart-dec-year, chart-ministries, chart-institutions, chart-heat, kpi:decided, kpi:paid_share, insight:ministry, insight:backlog, insight:cancel
decisions.סה~כ סכום ששולם: skip: 99.8% zero — a stale field; the computed paid total (סה~כ שולם מחושב) is used
decisions.שם המוסד אליו יועבר התשלום: chart-institutions — recipient institutions are public bodies and non-profits
